name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes federated playback repeatedly failing during transcoding, and cuts playback-start latency. Root cause: item-scoped playback tokens were re-minted over a WAN round trip on every relay request - and a transcoded federated mp4 re-opens its input stream several times per second while ffmpeg probes/seeks, so each re-open paid two WAN round trips (token mint + range fetch). On a ~300ms remote that starved ffmpeg's input until it exited with code 183 and the player retried, forever. Tokens are now cached per server/item/user (dropped eagerly when the remote rejects one, so a remote restart still recovers on the very next request), and the remote PlaybackInfo cache went from 5 to 15 minutes. The injected web-client UI was also reworked to match jellyfin-web's own styling: the source server now renders as a muted entry in the item info line and Download/Hide are native flat buttons in the detail page's own action row, replacing the custom uppercase pill chips. 223 tests.
